comment: Read from source at commit fb63bc3, the state the installed 2.0.0 matches: the six parameters carry the same ranges and defaults (rule 0 to 255 starting at 90, seed 0 to 255 starting at 30, low and high 0 to 28 starting at 0 and 14, scale 0 to 16, bit 0 to 7). THE MAKER'S OWN doc/more_ideas.md DISAGREES WITH THE CODE ABOUT THE thru / sel SWITCH. It says thru passes the input clock through to the clock output and sel pulses on any change of output CV. Neither is what happens: the clock output at lines 112 and 118 is 10V whenever the clock input is high and the chosen bit of the generation is 1, whichever way the switch is set. What the switch actually decides, at line 82, is whether the CV output is rewritten on every clock or only on a clock where the chosen bit is high. The maker's tooltip for it, Clock output mode, points at the clock output for the same reason and is wrong in the same way. The CV output is tagged pitch because the module comes up quantized; at raw it carries a plain control voltage over whatever span the menu names, so the colour is right for the default and not for both settings. The reset input is declared and drawn and read nowhere, so it gets a line saying so rather than being left to show an empty tooltip. All ten outputs and the eight lamp pairs are updated in subSampledProcess, which runs once every nine samples, so the gate edges follow the clock input to within that. None of the eight inputs is named with configInput, so Rack's own tooltips for them are empty.
